name: Vidya Wires Ltd
title: Vidya Wires Ltd - 544633 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue up 24.2% to ₹18,396mn with EBITDA margin 4.66%, but growth leaned on copper pass-through; ALCU capacity (~6,000 t installed of 18,000 t) only started Feb-26, and OCF conversion weak with 60-day working capital.

capex.peers_comment: Management said competition is always there and players will raise capacity when demand is strong; no specific peer capacity numbers given.
capex.quote: whenever there will be a better demand in the industry, so everybody would try to rise increase their capacities

triggers.label: ALCU capacity ~6,000 t of 18,000 t added
triggers.quote: we are already we have added some 6,000 metric tons of capacity and the remaining 8, 000 to 9,000 tons or so will be added

triggers.label: Working cycle ~60 days, debtors 41 days
triggers.quote: Currently it is at 60 days of working cycle

triggers.label: Q4 growth from copper price pass-through
triggers.quote: one is the increase in the copper prices in last 5, 6 months. So this has definitely boosted our revenue

triggers.label: No numeric FY27 guidance given
triggers.quote: directly I cannot give you any, you know, information that how much we will be able to do

guidance.quote: we will be close to -- by Diwali we will be close to 35, 00, 36,000 metric tons of capacity
we do expect that total capacity is 50% to 60% we should be able to utilize in this year
our target is that we should have a balance of 75% domestic and 25% export
we are at 41 days of debtors as of now, and we can definitely bring it down to around 35 days
we are taking measures to bring this down to say the levels of 50 to 52

guidance.value: No number; 'good growth' and better margins
guidance.quote: we are sure that we will maintain a good growth

red_flags.label: Q4 revenue growth 58% mostly copper price pass-through
red_flags.quote: one is the increase in the copper prices in last 5, 6 months. So this has definitely boosted our revenue

red_flags.label: Other expenses jump ~28mn to 83mn; expenses 'not considered' earlier
red_flags.quote: there were some expenses which we had not considered. They have been expensed out in this quarter

red_flags.label: Weak OCF conversion vs EBITDA
red_flags.quote: the OCF conversion was on the weaker side

red_flags.label: Vague answers on FY27 volumes and Q4 volume figures
red_flags.quote: Yes, we can provide you later on separately.

evasions.quote: I cannot comment on that ki we will be also in the same line to get INR66 per metric ton
directly I cannot give you any, you know, information that how much we will be able to do
I will just we'll get back to you for that exact increase in the percentage
So, sir, it's like that we have added more capacity.
